# Recap: our call on 7 October 2026

## Today
You are replacing the system that runs every step of an order, from booking to billing, across six depots and about 200 people, and the current one leaves support at the end of next year. A procurement committee and then the board will decide, through a formal request for proposals in January.

## What needs to change
A new system chosen by March and rolled out over about eighteen months.

## Next step
I'm not the right fit for this. I work with small firms of a few dozen people, and a selection and rollout of this size needs a team that runs formal procurements all the time. A firm that specialises in system selection for companies your size, or the implementation partners your shortlisted vendors recommend, would serve you better.

## What I need from you
- Nothing further. Thank you for your time, and good luck with the selection.

Robin
